_comment: THE SCRAP HAULER (#376): this mod's quarry, in the hand. Blueprint-gated (ruling 12), and the
bill of materials is where the quarry's price lives alongside its rate: a Battery, which is the
battery chain end to end; a Motor, the rarest component; a Bulb for the sensor head; rubber for
the treads, which is the tire dumps; and a Machine Frame. First-pass; tuning belongs with #36.
